# macro.saturation_intensity { #clerq.macro.saturation_intensity }

```python
macro.saturation_intensity(decay_rate, wavelength)
```

Saturation intensity of a cycling transition, ``pi h c Gamma / (3 lambda^3)``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                 | Default    |
|------------|--------|---------------------------------------------|------------|
| decay_rate | float  | Natural linewidth ``Gamma / 2 pi``, in MHz. | _required_ |
| wavelength | float  | Transition wavelength, in nm.               | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                            |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | float  | ``I_sat`` in mW/cm^2. For the Rb87 D2 line (6.065 MHz, 780.24 nm) this |
|        | float  | is 1.67 mW/cm^2.                                                       |
